subject: EdgeSecure private deployment alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@edgesecure.com>, EdgeSecure IT <it@edgesecure.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeSecure private deployment alignment

Sarah / team — thanks again for taking the time today. Short summary from our call and the actions we agreed on so everyone has the same view. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Regulatory requirement: customer data must remain in company-controlled datastores in the US (no replication to third-party cloud regions).
- Network lockdown: application tier cannot initiate outbound connections to public internet; only a restricted jump-host is allowed for controlled egress.
- Crypto/KMS: FIPS-validated key management and HSM integration required for keys in flight/at rest.
- Audit/retention: detailed audit logs for inference requests and retention controls for 1–7 years depending on dataset.

Goals and success criteria:
- VPC/private deployment reachable from EdgeSecure private network with zero direct outbound from app servers.
- Latency SLO: conversational features ~200ms p50; batch async jobs can be higher.
- Deployment timeline: target pilot in Q1 (60–90 days) followed by phased production rollout.
- Security signoffs: SOC 2 / encryption / network diagram approved by security + procurement PO in place.

Technical constraints we noted:
- No outbound TLS to public endpoints from app tier; we will need either (A) an outbound proxy/jump host pattern you control or (B) dedicated private peering into our Private control plane (if permitted).
- Allowed ports: 443 only from the jump-host; no additional ports.
- Egress inspection: corporate IDS/IPS will scan traffic; we need to supply expected IP ranges and FQDNs.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Redwood: share a lightweight VPC diagram + connector checklist (attached) and a sample SOW for an on-prem/private deployment. (Jordan / EOD 11/10)
2) EdgeSecure: share network egress policy and list of allowed jump-hosts / firewall rules. (EdgeSecure IT / by 11/13)
3) Security: provide SOC2 report + KMS/HSM integration notes. (Redwood / Monica to attach)
4) Schedule technical deep-dive (network + security) with your infra and our infra leads — propose Wed 11/15 10am PT. (All)

Attachments: redwood_vpc_diagram_v1.pdf, connector-checklist.xlsx.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@edgesecure.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeSecure IT <it@edgesecure.com>, Procurement <procurement@edgesecure.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 17:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: EdgeSecure private deployment alignment

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A few clarifications and asks from our side: 

1) HSM / KMS: we need an on-prem HSM integration (we run an AWS CloudHSM cluster in a dedicated VPC today). Can Redwood integrate with customer-managed HSMs or do you require Redwood's KMS? 
2) Data flow: to be clear, our app tier cannot accept any inbound connections from outside the VPC; the only allowed pattern is outbound to a controlled jump-host which performs proxying to partners. Is that supported by Redwood's connector approach?
3) Procurement timeline: we are wrapping Q4 budgets. Procurement asked for a ballpark TCV and a sample SOW to start legal review — I've looped them on this thread.

We'll consolidate the network egress policy doc and send over by EOD 11/13. Also: can you include a short note on how you handle tokenization/pseudonymization for PII before it's stored in logs?

— Sarah
Sarah Bennett
CTO, EdgeSecure
sarah.bennett@edgesecure.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@edgesecure.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@edgesecure.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeSecure private deployment alignment

Sarah / team — happy to provide the ballpark numbers to help procurement. Two quick notes up front: 1) we can support customer-managed HSM via our Private deployment; we have customers who mount HSMs over a secure VPN/peering and we surface KMS calls through a local connector, and 2) the jump-host/proxy pattern is a common approach — our connector is designed to work through outbound-only proxies when configured with your firewall rules.

High-level pricing (very approximate) for planning purposes:
- Private deployment (single-region, reserved capacity for pilot): ~$90k–$140k/month (includes dedicated GPU pool + support).
- One-time onboarding & SOW (engineering + security review): $35k–$60k depending on scope.
- Optional: extended retention / advanced audit logs add-on: $8k/month.

I've attached a sample SOW and a link to the HubSpot deal for EDGE-2028-004 where we will capture formal quotes. Jordan / Monica — once we lock the scope (HSM + egress model + retention), I can give procurement a tighter quote.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0198
From: EdgeSecure IT <it@edgesecure.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@edgesecure.com>, Procurement <procurement@edgesecure.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeSecure private deployment alignment

Jordan / Ben — thanks for the details. Confirming we will: 
- Share the network egress policy + current jump-host IPs by EOD today (attached: edgesecure-egress-policy.pdf).
- Schedule the technical deep-dive for Wed 11/15 10am PT — I'll send a calendar invite and include our infra/security leads.
- Procurement: we expect to have a draft PO template ready the week of 11/20 pending SOW finalization.

Quick note about testing: our infra team prefers an internal-only smoke test environment that can call Redwood endpoints via the jump-host (no public test tokens). Can Redwood provide short-lived test credentials scoped to a pilot VPC?

IT Team
EdgeSecure
it@edgesecure.com
